FRAME 8 PRINTED TWO NUMERALS THAT TRACED TO NOTHING, and both numeral gates were green over them. It labelled its axis bounds 1.0 and 0. aggregate_check cannot declare a bare axis label, so the declaration was refused, and numeral_trace passed them because the digits 1 and 0 occur somewhere in the evidence of a claim the frame cites, which is the coincidence its own docstring names as the case it cannot see. The first disposition was to ship them undeclared with a paragraph of explanation. That was wrong and the judge said so twice. The frame now draws both rules and names them SCALE TOP and SCALE BASE, printing no bound figure.
